hints.title: Initial Feasibility Check
hints.text: If both adjacent neighbors of (0, 0) require a time greater than 1, you can never make a first step, so reaching the destination is impossible.

hints.title: Ping-Pong Step Delay
hints.text: Once you can take a step, you can oscillate back and forth between two adjacent cells to waste time until the target cell unlocks.

hints.title: Parity Arrival Timing
hints.text: Because each round-trip oscillation takes 2 time units, the parity of the arrival time is constrained by the grid value and current time.

hints.title: Dijkstra Shortest Arrival Implementation

complexity.notes: Dijkstra priority exploration visits each grid cell with logarithmic heap operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard exploration without parity adjustment fails to account for waiting oscillations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) distance matrix and priority queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the unsolvable initial trap and parity-based delay calculation.
